headlines.snippet: Flavio Bolsonaro, who lost the Brazilian election, has reportedly left Brazil for Argentina and is en route to the United States. Brazilian police had previously prohibited him from leaving the country due to an investigation into money laundering and corruption.

headlines.title: דיווחים בברזיל: פלאביו בולסונארו, שהפסיד בבחירות, נמלט מהמדינה ועושה דרכו לארה"ב
headlines.snippet: Reports from Brazil indicate that Flavio Bolsonaro, who lost the presidential election, has fled the country and is heading to the US. Brazilian authorities have canceled his passport after he failed to surrender it, and his whereabouts remain undisclosed.

headlines.title: תחקיר באוסטרליה: ג'יימס פאקר שילם יותר ממיליון דולר למשרד עורכי דינו של נתניהו
headlines.snippet: An Australian investigation revealed that James Packer paid over $1 million to Netanyahu's law firm. The payments were made monthly by a company owned by Packer, though it was not proven that Netanyahu personally benefited.
